title: CardputerDict ADV 0.5.0 macOS Reviewer to Linux VSOCK saved-snapshot qualification

execution.environment: Apple Virtualization.framework with no Linux guest NIC; system macOS Python 3.9.6; pinned Linux QEMU

checks.detail: Authentication 401 and fixed-scope rejection 403; two SNTP and one TLS transactions match byte fingerprints
Both standard saved-snapshot requests admitted with HTTP 202 and used matching exact worker generation, original BIN and normalized Flash
Allowed: 10605-byte SD MP3 and 84992-byte captured I2S; denied: E_CARDPUTER_PRONUNCIATION_POLICY_DENIED with no SD cache or PCM
Both leases and mutable Flash released; Reviewer and VM stopped; host listener closed
Physical acoustics, RF and hardware behavior outside isolated virtual execution

notes: A1 failed before submitting any review because the private proof wrapper shadowed its HTTP import. Its owned VM exited and listener closed.
A2 qualifies exact binaries through isolated routing only. It did not change or exercise production traffic and did not submit to Burner.
